Profit margin: 3.9% (up from 0% in FY 2025). The increase in margin was driven by lower expenses. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 20% per year but the company’s share price has only increased by 13% per year, which means it is significantly lagging earnings growth.

news.title: New major risk - Shareholder dilution
news.body: The company's shareholders have been substantially diluted in the past year. Increase in shares outstanding: 420% This is considered a major risk. Shareholder dilution occurs when there is an increase in the number of shares on issue that is not proportionally distributed between all shareholders. Often due to the company raising equity capital or some options being converted into stock. All else being equal, if there are more shares outstanding then each existing share will be entitled to a lower proportion of the company's total earnings, thus reducing earnings per share (EPS). news.body: There are 5 new directors who have joined the board in the last 3 years. Of these new board members, 2 were independent directors. The company's board is composed of: 5 new directors. No experienced directors. No highly experienced directors. 2 independent directors (3 non-independent directors). MD & Executive Director Chirag Thumar is the most experienced director on the board, commencing their role in 2024. Additional Independent Director Dhairyakumar Thakkar was the last independent director to join the board, commencing their role in 2024.
